beta.notes:
Native Plex client for MiSTer. Built for CRTs at 480i over Component, RGB, S-Video or Composite, with 480p on HDMI.

Beta access. This is a paid early-access build. Install and browsing work without a code. Playback needs the code from the MisterZine Patreon post. Stable releases will be free and codeless.

New in beta.2
- Smoother playback: the app stays out of the decoder's way and the decoder skips the H.264 loop filter, so scenes that stuttered in beta.1 play clean
- Seeking keeps the last frame on screen instead of cutting to black
- Left/right with the controls hidden shows a strip with the title, progress bar and times; taps and holds add up into one seek
- The scrubber seeks on its own shortly after you let go, no OK needed
- Play cuts to black at once and shows the title and progress while the stream starts
- The 4:3 filter now judges shows by their first episode and applies to every library view
- An amber dot in the menu marks a waiting update; the Options page shows when it scrolls
- Update failures are explained on screen and kept in a log for diagnostics

Requirements
- Networked MiSTer on current MiSTer Linux
- 250 MB free on the SD card
- Plex account with a server that can transcode

Install
1. Download the Beta installer below and put it in the SD card's Scripts folder.
2. Run it from Scripts.
3. Follow the sign-in screen at plex.tv/link.

Already on beta.1: open Options > Updates in the app and install from there.

NTSC 480i only; PAL isn't supported yet. Beta software: start with a small test library, since playback and watched marks update your real Plex account.
